verdict.rationale: LangSmith's prebuilt per-project dashboards explicitly cover token usage. Custom dashboards can group data by run tag or metadata, and cost is a tracked metric for threshold alerts, so the core of token and cost monitoring is first-party. However, the evidence never states that cost appears in dashboards, or that per-request, per-model or time-period breakdowns are available. Missing for 10: explicit cost charts in dashboards, a documented per-model breakdown, per-request cost/token visibility, time-period views, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see cost and token usage per request, model, and time period in dashboards

citations.quote: Prebuilt dashboards are created automatically for each project and cover essential metrics, such as trace count, error rates, token usage, and more.
You can use group by run tag or metadata to split data over attributes that are important to your application.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
